system.description: The Airborne Beast dives sharply to attack an enemy at a lower altitude. When making a Charge attack, in addition to the competence bonus granted by the Charge attack, the Beast gains a + 1 circumstance bonus to its attack roll (up to a +5 total circumstance bonus) for every square the Beast moves downward. Additionally, the Beast can use a Move Action after resolving the Charge attack. Until the end of its next turn, the Beast takes a -2 penalty to its Reflex Defense because of the Charge Action.
